daily.today_energy: Mercury's got you feeling introspective today, Cap. It's giving quiet confidence energy—the kind where you don't need to prove anything to anyone. Perfect day to sit with your thoughts and let your intuition do the talking.
daily.love: Your people are craving more of you right now. Whether it's romantic or platonic, someone's noticing how much more present you've become. Don't overthink the small gestures—they're landing exactly where they need to.
daily.career: Ideas are flowing differently today; trust the unconventional angle you're considering. Your practical nature paired with today's creative vibes means you're seeing solutions others are missing. Jot them down before the moment passes.
daily.health: Your body's asking for slower, intentional movement today. Skip the intense workout and lean into stretching, walks, or something that feels grounding. Sometimes the best self-care is just listening to what you actually need.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to soften your edges, Cap. Mercury's moving through your sector of self-expression, so lean into vulnerability. Trust that showing up authentically actually makes you more powerful, not less.
weekly.love: If you've been holding back emotionally, the stars are gently pushing you forward. Whether single or coupled, this is your moment to let someone see the real you beneath all that composed exterior. Real connection starts with honest presence.
weekly.career: Your work momentum is building quietly in the background. Focus on laying groundwork rather than seeking immediate recognition. Small consistent efforts this week plant seeds for something meaningful. Let your dedication speak louder than words.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for grounding practices this week. Whether that's yoga, long walks, or just sitting outside, honor the call to slow down. Energy flows where intention goes—direct yours toward genuine rest and self-care rituals.
